exercises.title: 6. Pratique: Future forms — will, going to, present continuous

items.prompt: We ___ the talent review in March — it's all confirmed.
I think Maria ___ ready for a senior role soon.
items.hintAfterError: Previsão baseada em opinião ('I think') pede o futuro simples.

items.prompt: Sophie ___ the succession plan to the board on Friday.
items.hintAfterError: Compromisso já marcado na agenda: Present Continuous (be + -ing).

items.prompt: He ___ the finance team next quarter — it's decided.
Good idea! I ___ you the report right after the meeting.
items.hintAfterError: Decisão tomada no momento da fala usa o futuro simples.
